Reusing the name for this unrelated Workstation->Operation relationship silently merged both domains via RDF triple accumulation, forcing any Workstation asserted here to also be inferred as an Order -- a real BFO-disjoint contradiction (Independent Continuant vs Generically Dependent Continuant) that made the whole ontology inconsistent under a real DL reasoner.
